pull.title: bip-0375: reject inputs with missing UTXO or redeem script instead of crashing
pull.body:
The BIP-375 reference validator crashes with an `AssertionError`, instead of rejecting the PSBT, on three malformed inputs: no `PSBT_IN_WITNESS_UTXO` and no `PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO`; `PSBT_IN_OUTPUT_INDEX` past the end of the non-witness UTXO; a P2SH scriptPubKey without `PSBT_IN_REDEEM_SCRIPT`. All three reach the asserts in `validator/inputs.py` from `is_input_eligible`. Measured on master `b34d9f75`.

The first commit raises `ValueError` there and lets `validate_bip375_psbt` report it as a failed check; `test_runner.py` still passes master's 44 of 44. The second adds one invalid vector per case, listed in the BIP table under ECDH Coverage, the check that rejects them: 47 of 47 with the fix, and each vector alone fails the master validator with an `AssertionError`. A separate commit sets Version 0.1.6 with its changelog entry: 0.1.5 is #2316's, and whichever of the two lands second rebases its version if needed.

*Made with my usual tools: a computer, the Internet and an LLM. The mistakes, as usual, are all mine.*

events.body:
Beyond what this PR fixes, on master `b34d9f75` the validator crashes on three more kinds of invalid PSBT, and accepts a hybrid `PSBT_IN_BIP32_DERIVATION` key with the wrong parity prefix.

A fix with test vectors is on my fork, free to use: https://github.com/fametrano/bips/pull/6. @macgyver13 @jonatack, would you rather someone take it as a separate PR, or have me fold it into this PR or #2316? Folding keeps one version bump but grows a reviewed PR.
